title: Inception thinking graph
description: The single source of truth for an inception session. PRD / decisions / action-items / open-questions documents are projections rendered from this graph.

session.description: The PRD fields. Together they render a foundational PRD meant to be a long-term anchor, not a thin summary. Write all of them in plain, clear English.

topic.description: Short kebab-case slug for the idea/project.

summary.description: One or two sentences: what this is and the role it plays. The elevator pitch.

background.description: Permanent context and why now — the standing situation that makes this worth doing. Not session-process narration (what was questioned/decided goes to Decision nodes) and not a progress snapshot (implementation status goes to the tracker). Still true months later. See prd-template.md 'Background: permanent context'.

problem.description: The core problem/pain being addressed. Stated from the user's perspective, not as a solution.

purpose.description: Purpose / long-term vision — the lasting positioning this is meant to hold.

centralQuestion.description: The single question the session is organized around (problem-first).

targetUsers.description: Who this is for — primary and secondary users, with enough specificity to be falsifiable.

valueProposition.description: The core value and differentiation — why this is better than the status quo or alternatives.

nonGoals.description: What is explicitly out of scope — bounds that keep the concept focused.

phase.description: Current phase. The AI proposes transitions; the user approves.

type.description: Idea/Question: raised material. Insight: something learned. Counter: an objection/premise attack. Decision: a settled choice (see decision field). Action: concrete work.

parentId.description: Issue-tree parent. null for a root-level node.

dependsOn.description: Ids this node is blocked by. Used to find the most foundational open node to discuss next.

status.description: open: still in the queue. resolved: closed and its outcome captured (often as a Decision/Action). deferred: intentionally postponed. dropped: won't pursue.

nextMove.description: For OPEN nodes: the planned next move. Not an intrinsic type — it changes as the point matures. decide=user picks an option; investigate=find out; validate=test cheaply; deepen=discuss further.

deferReason.description: Required in spirit for status=deferred: why it is postponed.

decision.description: Present only for type=Decision. Records rejected alternatives so the choice does not get re-litigated later.
